# 🐄 Hare Krishna Dairy Farm - Brand Guidelines

**Version:** 1.0  
**Last Updated:** February 2026

## Brand Identity

### Official Names

**Legal/Official Name:**

> Hare Krishna Krishi tatha Pashu Panchhi Farm (Registered Dairy & Farm)

**Short/Display Name (for UI):**

> Hare Krishna Dairy Farm

**Tagline:**

> "Pure Milk from Our Village to Your Home"

**Alternative Taglines:**

- "Fresh, Trusted & Locally Sourced Dairy"
- "Traditional Dairy from a Registered Village Farm"

---

## Core Brand Values

### 1. **Quality over Quantity** 🎯

We prioritize quality dairy products over large-scale production. Every product is made with care.

### 2. **Honesty & Transparency** 🔓

- Fixed pricing (no fluctuation)
- Transparent billing process
- No hidden charges
- Simple, honest communication

### 3. **Community First** 🤝

- Support for local farmers
- Credit system for village people
- Part of the village, not separate
- Personal relationships with customers

### 4. **Traditional Methods** 📜

- Time-tested dairy making processes
- No artificial additives
- Respect for traditional knowledge
- Sustainable farming practices

### 5. **Trust & Reliability** 💚

- Consistent quality
- Regular supply
- Personal service
- Long-term relationships

---

## Visual Identity

### Color Palette

**Primary Colors:**

- **Green (#16a34a)** - Symbol of nature, growth, health
- **Dark Green (#15803d)** - Trust, reliability
- **Light Green (#dcfce7)** - Approachability

**Secondary Colors:**

- **Blue (#2563eb)** - Credibility, professionalism
- **Gray (#4b5563)** - Neutrality, balance
- **White (#ffffff)** - Purity, cleanliness

**Accent Colors:**

- **Yellow (#eab308)** - Warmth, happiness
- **Neutral Gray (#64748b)** - Professional text

### Typography

- **Headings:** Bold, readable, welcoming
- **Body Text:** Clear, easy-to-read on mobile and desktop
- **Emphasis:** Use color and weight, not size alone

### Imagery

- **Farm Photos:** Real, authentic images of cows, dairy process, village life
- **Icons:** Emoji-based (🐄🥛👨‍🌾🌾) for universal understanding
- **Style:** Natural, unfiltered, honest representation

---

## Content Guidelines

### Tone of Voice

**Be:**

- ✅ Honest and transparent
- ✅ Warm and approachable
- ✅ Simple and clear
- ✅ Professional but personal
- ✅ Respectful of customers

**Don't:**

- ❌ Use corporate jargon
- ❌ Make false claims
- ❌ Be overly formal
- ❌ Use complex technical language
- ❌ Sound impersonal

### Key Messages

| Message                    | Explanation                   |
| -------------------------- | ----------------------------- |
| "Fresh from our farm"      | Quality, directly from source |
| "Trusted by the village"   | Long-standing relationships   |
| "Fixed price, fair system" | Transparent, honest pricing   |
| "Traditional methods"      | Authentic, quality process    |
| "Credit available"         | Community-focused service     |

### Language Approach

1. **For English:** Clear, simple, friendly
2. **For Nepali:** Natural, respectful, community-focused
3. **Always:** Honest, transparent, authentic

---

## Website Design Principles

### ✨ NOT Generic AI-Generated

- Custom color scheme (green, farm-appropriate)
- Handcrafted layouts for specific pages
- Emoji-based visual elements
- Authentic farm story
- Unique component designs

### 📱 Mobile-First

- Works perfectly on phones
- Large, readable text
- Easy taps/buttons
- Fast loading

### ♿ Accessible

- High contrast colors
- Clear hierarchy
- Large text options
- Semantic HTML
- Keyboard navigation

### 🎨 Farm-Themed

- Green earth tones
- Natural, organic feel
- Rural-appropriate imagery
- Community-focused language

---

## Key Differentiators

### Why Choose Us vs. Big Dairies?

| Factor       | Hare Krishna      | Big Commercial  |
| ------------ | ----------------- | --------------- |
| Price        | Fixed, fair       | Fluctuating     |
| Quality      | Personal care     | Mass production |
| Relationship | Personal, trusted | Anonymous       |
| Credit       | Available         | Usually not     |
| Community    | Village-based     | Corporate       |
| Transparency | Complete          | Limited         |
